svg.text: LEGEND — BODIES are filled; CORES are solid outlines with no fill; SCHEMATIC objects (centre boxes, clipped boxes, lane cells) are THIN DASHED outlines with no fill and are NOT square bodies. | PANEL 1, the LP dual support of this node's record at s0: fill = dual weight y on one sequential scale (pale yellow y->0, dark orange y=1);

grey P0..P4 = the PINS, drawn as pins (zero-tilt-width cores), each carrying BOTH inner cores — thin light blue = the STOCK pin core (half-side 1/2 - delta = 0.49, what the LP pruned against), thin dark blue = A135's EXACT pin core (half-side 1/2 - delta/sqrt2, certified); bright cyan + H = the conditioned square at the centre of its

CLIPPED box and the MID-TILT, faint cyan = the two extremal tilts. H carries THREE cores: solid BLACK = the stock axis core K(a) the LP pruned against, solid TEAL = A135's exact axis core, filled PURPLE = the certified polygon core K'(B) (A132) — a_stock / a_exact / area K' are captioned in panel 3. Black dashed = the original centre

box; orange dashed = the pin-clipped centre box (A131). RED DASHED = a dual-support column that overlaps a hypothesis square — H OR a pin — at EVERY pose of its box; each is labelled with WHICH cores it clears and which it meets. | PANEL 2 = a real packing: blue = slot square (named cell), red = free square (f-index + tilt), green

ring = contact at gap < 1e-6; these are the names the PI labels from. | PANEL 3 = the hypothesis alone: the three cores captioned, the clip per tilt sub-bin, the lane <= 1 corner cells and the measured pockets.
